objective: Ship This as a Finished Product.

source_inspections.bounded_subject: Enterprise Architecture alignment within the single authorized CETA product
source_inspections.decision_reason: The coordinated people, process, information, technology, governance and lifecycle concerns support CETA architecture. Small size is not an exemption. Current authority does not include organization-wide policy, investments, portfolio consolidation or other personal repositories; no approved enterprise baseline is assumed.

clause_allocations.original_clause_family: Required outcome, applicability, ownership and alignment
Shared capabilities, authority, dependencies and transition

source_inspections.remaining_obligations: Keep CETA alignment and shared-contract ownership explicit. Do not invent an organization, staffing, enterprise commitments or an accepted baseline. Reopen for material shared-service or enterprise decisions within expressly authorized scope; broader authority requires a separately identified source, destination and scope.
source_inspections.reopening_condition: Any material change to this source, scope, owner, meaning, authority, interface, data, model, environment, evidence or lifecycle assumption.

source_inspections.decision_reason: The assigned ground-up native, persistent, offline AI system materially changes responsibilities, authority, state, effects, recovery and lifecycle. It is not an exploratory artifact or a minor change covered by a verified architecture baseline.

clause_allocations.original_clause_family: Scope, alternatives, context, allocation and solution views
Interface contracts, authority, state, failure and control
Risk, verification, transition, operation and continuity

source_inspections.remaining_obligations: Every component needs an attributable purpose and allowed inputs, outputs, authority, state and failure path. Each interface needs producer, consumer, version, schema, timing, errors, retry, idempotency, cancellation and evidence. The kernel remains the sole positive authority; model loss must not remove stop, status, evidence or recovery. Working leaf contracts and engineering decisions do not establish whole solution readiness.

source_inspections.decision_reason: Persistent cognition, protected authority, native UI, helpers, external effects and lifecycle require coherent system, state, trust, deployment and failure views. source_inspections.remaining_obligations: Separate operational truth, evidence and monitoring. All UI, API, agent, administration, retry and recovery paths must use the same current authority and state checks. Correlated store, clock, credential, model, administrator or observer failures remain explicit. Actual independent readback, crash/restart, backup/restore and revocation enforcement remain unimplemented.

source_inspections.bounded_subject: Functions, inputs, outputs, controls and outcome allocation
source_inspections.decision_reason: Material functions must be allocated independently of process sequence and implementation packaging. Cross-cutting authority, privacy, quality, accessibility, resilience and recovery cannot remain ownerless prose.

clause_allocations.original_clause_family: Function purpose, decomposition, allocation and contracts
Protected outcomes, controls, quality and specialty functions
Failure, lifecycle, validation and continuity

source_inspections.remaining_obligations: Each material function needs a source, purpose, owner, input/output conditions, dependency, criticality, authority, timing, errors, quality measure, version and evidence. A component may realize several functions and a function several implementations; neither confers permission. Stop, correction, accessibility, manual appeal and recovery must remain usable during model failure. The registry checker verifies declared links only, not actual function ownership, runtime orphan detection or interface adequacy.

source_inspections.bounded_subject: Data structure, lineage, quality and full lifecycle
source_inspections.decision_reason: CETA receives, persists, transforms, retrieves, generates, exports, migrates and deletes consequential data. No small payload, table or model input is exempt merely because it is small. The exact data inventory, quality thresholds and physical migration behavior remain unfinished.

clause_allocations.original_clause_family: Entities, events, meaning, contracts, sources, flows and lineage
Quality, privacy, integrity, custody, access and AI derivatives
Retention, deletion, quarantine, migration, restore and verification

source_inspections.remaining_obligations: Distinguish source, derived record, cache, replica, backup, archive, synthetic value, feature, model artifact and evidence copy. Bind purpose, subject, sensitivity, source authority, version, freshness, access, transformation and retention at actual boundaries. Quarantine malformed, stale, poisoned, unauthorized, incompatible or corrupted data without silently dropping evidence. Deletion must describe residual indexes, logs, backups, models and exports; checksums or schema-valid pipelines cannot prove accuracy or lawful use. Never inspect normal data or keys to invent an inventory.

boundary_allocations.required_contract_behavior: Admit exact scoped subscriptions under current authority; distinguish observed values and observational gaps from inferred or generated values. Persist source/version, timing, provenance and payload commitments, without duplicating sensitive data into plaintext evidence.
boundary_allocations.remaining_implementation: Actual capture permission, OS resource handles, transactional writer, gap reconciliation and retention enforcement.

boundary_allocations.required_contract_behavior: Compile exact source/derivative states, contradictions, revisions, purpose, permissions and omissions. Retrieval is not a grant. Bind qualified model/provider/template/assets/hardware identities and reject stale or revoked context.
boundary_allocations.remaining_implementation: Real compiler, derivative-access invalidation, qualified owned offline inference and independent semantic quality evaluation.

boundary_allocations.required_contract_behavior: Treat every model or orchestration proposal as untrusted. Check authentic current identity/consent, exact candidate and policy, review, resource revisions, revocation, budgets and lifetimes before durable intent and one-use permit issuance. No UI, graph, role, receipt, imported grant or recovery bypass.
boundary_allocations.remaining_implementation: Authenticated identities, policy predicates, current authority issuance, atomic reservation and actual custody/review boundaries.

boundary_allocations.boundary: Broker redemption, effect, independent readback and settlement
boundary_allocations.required_contract_behavior: Authenticate OS peer and receiver generation; bind task/session/attempt, operation, commitments, deadlines, fences and real resource handles. Consume once before effect admission. Acknowledgment or process exit is not outcome. Receipt loss preserves indeterminate state; readback or independently evidenced idempotency precedes settlement, and compensation requires fresh authority.
boundary_allocations.remaining_implementation: Native authenticated transport and containment, real consume/effect ordering, separately attributable observation and transactional settlement.

boundary_allocations.required_contract_behavior: Keep original signed evidence distinct from derived projections, caches, embeddings and generated contexts. Propagate correction, revocation, supersession and deletion through known dependencies, retain only authorized tombstones/commitments, and declare retained backups/external copies without promising universal forgetting.
boundary_allocations.remaining_implementation: Actual copy/lineage inventory, purpose and quality rules, access gates, retention/deletion execution and residual-copy verification.

boundary_allocations.boundary: Supervisor, owner controls and all application entry paths
boundary_allocations.required_contract_behavior: Distinguish process definition from current instance and running work from settled outcomes. Apply the same admission guards across UI, API, agents, batch, event, administration, offline and recovery surfaces. Reserve stop, status, diagnostics, evidence and recovery capacity during model, source, key, monitoring or storage failure.
boundary_allocations.remaining_implementation: Persistent lifetimes and mode guards, actual controls/accessibility, no-model recovery, measured capacity and installed/endurance qualification.

boundary_allocations.required_contract_behavior: Use verified isolated snapshots and category-specific reconciliation; preserve unsupported/corrupt material with navigable provenance. New genesis references legacy history without claiming historical execution or reviving grants, readiness or keys. Rehearse restore and compatible activation; exact owner cutover precedes normal-profile replacement and retirement of old live paths.
boundary_allocations.remaining_implementation: Schema-specific readers/converters, dry imports, restoration/compatibility evidence, actual candidate packaging, independent assurance and owner-reserved activation.

common_transport_obligations: Bound length before allocation/decoding; reject duplicate keys and unsupported critical fields; exact schema and canonical commitment.
Version, message/correlation/causation identity, authentic sender session and receiving service generation, operation, bounded body commitment and validity.
Actual OS peer/lifetime evidence, current authority and resource scope, replay protection, relevant-state revisions, revocation and fence.
Receipt versus completion, timeout, retry, idempotency, cancellation, indeterminate effect, recovery and evidence ownership.
Redacted permitted-consumer data; no general shell, SQL, arbitrary signing, caller-selected handles or unsafe object deserialization.
data_classes_requiring_inventory: Memory/graph projections, indexes, embeddings and caches
Effect receipts, observations and evidence copies
Backups, exports, logs and support copies
inventory_limits: Categories are design obligations, not observed contents, accepted retention rules, lawful-purpose determinations or measured quality thresholds.
